reason: Both sell subscription cloud software to small businesses, so customers and the business model overlap. The products differ. Thryv sells marketing, CRM and lead-management software plus done-for-you marketing services to local service businesses. Crexendo sells hosted business phone, UCaaS and contact-center services, with white-label channel partners and telecom regulation. Crexendo's AI call tools do not make it a marketing-software competitor. Overlap is on customers and model only, so the grade is adjacent.
